## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a build-blocking MDX syntax error in the chatbot plugin documentation. The Turbopack build was failing due to invalid JSX attribute syntax where a colon (`:`) was incorrectly used instead of an equals sign (`=`) for the `description` prop.

**Changes:**
- Fixed JSX attribute syntax from `description: "..."` to `description="..."` on line 37 of `plugin-chatbot.mdx`
